pages.title: Keep parallel table loads for the nightly ingest
pages.verdict: Keep parallel loads. The window shrank by a third with no failed table; the slipped backfill is a schema issue, not a load issue.
interpretations: Five nights in a row finished before 03:00 with parallel loads.
The seven baseline failures were lock timeouts that serial loads no longer hide.

pages.title: Backfill in monthly batches rather than one pass

columns.label: Monthly batches
points: A failed month reruns on its own

tradeoff.why: Two months already reran this week; a single pass would have restarted the whole history.
tradeoff.cost: The checkpoint table must stay in step with schema changes.

pages.title: The nightly window fell for eight weeks and sits just above target
pages.interpretation: Parallel loads brought the fictional window from 94 to 61 minutes. The holiday week has no run, and the latest week is one minute above the 60-minute ceiling.
pages.measurementContext: Fictional log: median nightly window for each Monday-to-Friday week, in minutes.
